Goal IDs are present but their names, types and firing conditions are not available in the current export. GA4 session and event pulls for 17–20 November returned no rows. The data cannot yet support a verified discovery-to-lead funnel.
items.decision_to_unlock: Can Search Console, Yandex Metrica and GA4 be reconciled into one trustworthy host-normalized funnel, and which goal events genuinely represent contact or qualified enquiry actions?
items.hypothesis: A reproducible export schema, verified host behavior and a native goal dictionary will separate acquisition, route engagement and real contact actions; this will expose whether the current blank GA4 read is a tag/access issue or a connector/property issue.
success_criteria: Re-run identical Metrica date windows and identical field schemas; preserve request parameters, row counts, extraction timestamps and pagination details so record-count drift is measurable.
Use the authorized native goal list to map every active Metrica goal ID to name, type, status, firing condition and last verification date; do not count unmapped IDs as leads.
Read-only test both host variants for the homepage and the five P0 commercial/English routes; record HTTP response, redirect target, canonical, tracker IDs and duplicate pageview behavior.

Use authorized GA4 Realtime/DebugView or an equivalent read-only signal to verify page_view, hostname, source/medium, form events and successful contact actions; do not infer zero traffic from an empty connector response.

Publish a revised baseline only after the denominator, host normalization and goal semantics pass explicit reproducibility checks; keep search clicks, AI-tagged URLs, citations, contacts and qualified enquiries separate.

items.title: Separate Audio+ short-order pricing from professional business routes in GEO answers
items.obstacle: The repository GEO source model mixes Audio+ short-order pricing with professional buyer intents and also fails to encode buyer eligibility, fulfillment model, output granularity, revision/rework rules and rights model. The available official Audio+ offer snapshot states that the buyer is an individual and not a legal entity or individual entrepreneur, gives a non-exclusive licence structure and limits rework; the separate professional radio page advertises transfer of author and exclusive rights. Both sources are stale snapshots and one product-page edit statement conflicts with the offer wording. Public GEO serving remains NOT_TESTED.
items.decision_to_unlock: Determine which existing Audio+ price statements belong only to an eligible individual short-order buyer, which commercial intents must route to their matching professional studio services, and how the generator, shared FAQ and legacy static pages should be updated without publishing unsupported prices or scope.
items.hypothesis: Encoding buyer eligibility and product/service identity separately in the GEO source model, then routing business-intent answers through the verified service registry, should reduce the risk that a company or individual entrepreneur interprets Audio+ short-order prices as a professional project quote. This is a source-readiness hypothesis, not evidence of live misrouting or improved AI citations.
success_criteria: Freshly re-read the current Audio+ primary offer and record its current buyer eligibility, scope, limits, price and change terms; do not carry forward 2026-10-20/2026-11-15 price observations as current without source evidence.
Confirm the intended public serving state of the GEO surface; inaccessible web-reader results must remain NOT_TESTED, not be treated as a site outage.
Separate Audio+ as a short-order product from professional studio services in the data model, visible labels, generated hub/pricing/FAQ/llms content and structured data.

Route radio, scriptwriting, jingles, corporate songs, video production, video voice-over, presentations, IVR, localization and audiobooks through the matching SERVICE_ROUTE_REGISTRY destination; do not assign a professional quote from Audio+ tariffs.
Remove any company Service/Offer markup that attributes B2C Audio+ price offers to the professional studio service unless a fresh primary source explicitly justifies that relationship.
Use tools/build_geo_site.py and the actual knowledge source files as the source of truth for generated outputs; first establish provenance for legacy answer HTML files not listed in EXTRA_ANSWERS.
Ensure shared FAQ structured data contains only questions and answers relevant to each generated page and does not inject Audio+ prices into unrelated professional-service pages.
Keep public GEO assets, the official website, GitHub Pages deployment and main branch unchanged until the owner explicitly approves the scoped changes; deployment remains a separate approval.

Preserve buyer eligibility, fulfillment, delivery granularity, revision/rework and rights as separate boundary dimensions; do not transfer the Audio+ non-exclusive licence wording to professional routes or assume that every professional quote includes exclusive-right transfer.
Resolve the Audio+ product-page edit/correction statement against the offer clauses on text changes and reworking recorded materials before describing the current edit entitlement or fee.
Keep every source's retrieval age and freshness visible; a cached official page is not a freshly verified current commercial term.
items.blocker: GEO assets are intended for external publication and require explicit owner approval before edits. Current Audio+ contractual terms are not freshly verified; the available offer is a stale snapshot published in 2016 and crawled about five months ago. The product page's paid edit option and offer clauses on changes/rework require owner clarification. Public GEO serving is NOT_TESTED.
items.unblock_condition: The owner explicitly approves the exact internal GEO source files in scope; current Audio+ offer and product-page terms, including the edit/rework distinction and buyer eligibility, are freshly verified; product rights wording is confirmed; provenance for legacy HTML is established. Any deployment remains a separate explicit approval.
